chunks: Muhammad ibn al-Hasan ibn Ahmad ibn al-Walid, may Allah have mercy on him, narrated to me from Abu al-Khattab from Abdullah ibn Ziyad who said:

We greeted Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) in Mina, then I said, 'O son of Allah's Messenger, we are people passing through; we are not able to attend your sessions whenever we wish, so advise us.' He (peace be upon him) said: 'Upon you is God-consciousness, truthfulness of speech, fulfillment of trusts, good companionship with those who accompany you, spreading of greetings, and feeding of food. Pray in their mosques, visit their sick, and follow their funerals. For indeed my father narrated to me that our Shias, the People of the House, were the best of their people. If there was a jurist among them, he was from us; if there was a muezzin among them, he was from us; if there was an imam among them, he was from us; if there was a keeper of trusts among them, he was from us; and if there was a keeper of deposits among them, he was from us. And thus be, so that you make us beloved to the people and do not make us hateful to them.'

key_terms.أَهْلَ الْبَيْتِ: The People of the House (Ahl al-Bayt)

ai.seo_question: What are the key ethical virtues and social behaviors that make the Shia beloved to people according to the Imam?
ai.summary: Abdullah ibn Ziyad narrates that the Imam (peace be upon him) advised his followers to cultivate pi, truthfulness, fulfilling trusts, good companionship, spreading greetings, and feeding food. The Imam emphasized that the best scholars, muezzins, imams, and trustworthy individuals among people are from the Shia, and by embodying these traits, they make the Ahl al-Bayt beloved to the people.

en.badr-shahin: Mohammed bin al-Hasan bin al-Waleed, Allah may have mercy upon him, narrated to me from Mohammed bin al-Hasan as-Saffar from Mohammed bin al-Hussein bin Abu al-Khattab… that Abdullah bin Ziyad related:

In Mina, we greeted Abu Abdullah (a) and said, “O son of Allah’s Messenger, we are itinerant people. We cannot attend your sessions. Hence, we ask you to give us some advices.” The Imam (a) said: Cling to God-fearing, truthfulness, fulfillment of the trusts that are deposited with you, good company with whoever accompanies you, spread of salutation, and serving of food. Offer prayers in the mosques of people, visit the ailed, and participate in their funeral ceremonies. My father told me that the adherents of us –the Prophet’s household- were the best of their folks. The jurisprudent of any people was the Shiite. The muezzin of any people was the Shiite. The most trustful of any people was the Shiite. The most dependable of any people was the Shiite. Thus, you should carry such characters. Lead people to love us. Do not make them hate us.
